verdict.rationale: Pipedream's docs show it emails you by default when a workflow throws an unhandled error, which covers the notification half of the story. It also documents automatic retries and error details with stack traces. Nothing in the pack shows dedicated error-handling paths or separate error workflows that run on failure; retries are a related feature, not an error path. Missing for 10: documented dedicated error-handling paths or error workflows, configurable notification channels beyond default email, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define dedicated error-handling paths or error workflows and get notified when a run fails

citations.quote: By default, Pipedream sends an email when a workflow throws an unhandled error.
You can automatically retry events that yield an error.
Pipedream will surface details about the error and the stack trace
